name: talewright
description: Talemark highlighting, substitution previews, rich hover, completion/navigation, story configuration schema, and live compiler diagnostics.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Live validation launches the bundled language server (or an explicit development override) only in trusted workspaces.

command.description: Open the native Author Debugger; not a VS Code debug adapter.

story.description: Canonical story-root path within an open workspace folder. Relative paths in workspace-scoped tasks must identify exactly one story across the open folders.

talewright.cli.executablePath.description: Absolute path to the separately installed Talewright CLI executable. Leave empty to use talewright on PATH or in ~/.dotnet/tools. Use Talewright: Set Up CLI for explicit installation guidance; never uses the bundled language server.

talewright.languageServer.enabled.description: Enable shared live diagnostics, completion, and hover. Reload the window after changing settings.

talewright.languageServer.command.description: Leave empty to use the bundled platform-specific server. Linux x64 is runtime-tested; other platforms have provisional support. Set an executable explicitly only for development; never installed or built automatically.

talewright.languageServer.args.description: Server arguments; for a local build use dotnet with the server DLL followed by --stdio.

talewright.languageServer.metadataPath.description: Explicit data-only authoring metadata file, absolute or relative to each story root.

talewright.languageServer.requiresProjec.description: Require exported project registrations, including for external/nested C# projects. Missing metadata produces TW5001.
